## Summary
This video demonstrates how to integrate a real-time, human-like AI voice agent into a Next.js application using the ElevenLabs React SDK. It covers the end-to-end process from configuring an agent in the ElevenLabs dashboard to implementing session controls and microphone permissions in code.

## Key Points
- ElevenLabs provides a conversational AI platform currently in beta that allows for low-latency voice interactions.
- Integration is simplified through a dedicated React SDK and the useConversation hook.
- AI agents can be customized with specific system prompts, knowledge bases, and tool-calling capabilities.
- Security is handled by adding production domains to an allow-list within the ElevenLabs dashboard.
- The implementation requires handling browser-level microphone permissions using the Media Devices API.

## AI Concepts
Conversational AI, Low-latency speech-to-speech, LLM (Large Language Model) Providers, Knowledge Bases / RAG, Tool Calling, Natural Language Processing, Conversational State Management
